audited_differences.assessment: Adds a direct-age fallback for public clock line-search failures. The correlated internal clock initializer explicitly passes _direct_age_fallback=False.
Explicitly disables the new clock fallback for its internal warm start, preserving the V16 initialization, objective, profiled rate solver, multistarts, and fit selection.
Adds an optional args=() pass-through. Existing correlated calls omit it and therefore retain identical arguments and fitted-value behavior.
